title: Lundey UI component diagram
description: The canvas drawing, the drawn cast, the controls and the sound effects, each reading the engine's types.

components.name: Lundey UI
components.responsibility: The browser-facing pieces the page wires together.

components.name: Renderer (render.ts)
components.responsibility: Draws a Game: the island and its burrow in the level's season, what lies in the tunnels, the puffin and the hunters, the score line, and the title, ready, paused, cleared and game-over words.

components.name: Art (art.ts)
components.responsibility: The puffin, the fox, the mink, the skua, the raven, a tern, a sand eel, a feather and the five treats, each drawn with canvas shapes; the hunters' coats.

components.name: Controls (input.ts)
components.responsibility: Keyboard, swipes, on-screen buttons and a gamepad as one Input a step.

components.name: Sound (sound.ts)
components.responsibility: Web Audio effects made on the fly, one for each game event, and the terns' cry.

components.name: Engine
components.responsibility: The Game, its burrows and its numbers.

relationships.description: Every character and pickup, and the coats.
